notes: Diagrams done in the same pass. Charts added programmatically from each problem's own numbers, all with evenly-spaced category-axis labels so gradients read faithfully. bronze[0]/bronze[1] shared chart repaired (see main changes file). Deliberately NO chart on gold[2] (runner): its two phases (20 s then 30 s) are unequal in time, so a faithful category-axis line is not possible and the key numbers are given in the text; a mislabelled figure would be worse than none. SVGs are theme-safe (currentColor text/axes, soft shaded fill at 0.3 opacity), self-contained, and under 3.1 KB each. Validator PASS on the live row.
